name: Hawk Core
author: wpinterface

sections.description:
Hawk Core is the official companion plugin for the Hawk Theme.
It extends the theme with powerful features, including:
– Custom widgets
– Gutenberg blocks
– Elementor and other page builder support
– A collection of pre-built demo websites to help you launch quickly

If you’re using the Hawk theme, installing Hawk Core unlocks its full potential 🚀.

External services

This plugin connects to an API to obtain demo content, which is required to import the sample data (posts, pages, widgets, and Customizer settings) included with the theme.
It sends a request to our server only when the user chooses to import the demo. No personal or sensitive information is transmitted — the API is used solely to retrieve the demo data package.

This service is provided by WPInterface.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress dashboard → Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Hawk Core.
  3. Click Install Now, then activate the plugin.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the hawk-core.zip file.
  2. Upload it to /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it through the WordPress Add Plugins → Upload Plugin option.
  3. Activate Hawk Core from the Plugins menu.
sections.faq:
I installed the plugin but nothing happened. Why?

Hawk Core works only with the Hawk Theme.
Make sure the Hawk theme is installed and active.
